nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
Bold comic-book ink style, heavy linework, red and blue-black palette, night city. Use <Picture 2> and <Picture 1> as reference frames and <Audio 1> exactly as it is.
CUT 1: top-down view of the little boy superhero on the rooftop — red cape fluttering in the wind, hands planted on his hips, freckles and a cocky grin as he looks straight up into the camera. The camera slowly descends toward him as he delivers his line — as he speaks, comic-book graphic overlay text word by word in sync with his voice: "GET READY TO" - "MEET" — "YOUR" — "MAKER" — huge jagged comic lettering, white with heavy black outlines and red drop shadows, tilted at scrappy angles, until the three words hang stacked in the air above him between his face and the lens.
TRANSITION: a violent WHIP PAN off the rooftop that SMEARS the floating words away with it, motion-streaked —
CUT 2: low hero angle on the colossal black mech-kaiju towering over the skyline as it rears back and unleashes a GIANT terrifying ROAR — jaws wide with fangs, red eyes and chest-core flaring blinding bright, blue lightning arcing off its head, the roar's shockwave rippling dust and rattling windows down the buildings, comic-style speed-lines and ink splatter bursting from the impact of the sound. It leans INTO the camera as the roar peaks. Hold on the roar.

以 <Picture 1> 作为视频中唯一人物的身份、角色设计、三维模型、面部建模、发型、身体比例、服装设计、材质表现和整体 3D CG 风格参考。

严格保持 <Picture 1> 中人物原有的 3D 虚拟角色风格，不要将人物转换成真人，不要进行真人化、摄影写实化或真实人脸重建。保持原参考图中的面部抽象程度、五官建模方式、眼睛大小与形状、脸部轮廓、鼻子和嘴唇造型、皮肤 shader、发丝表现、身体比例以及角色原有的游戏 CG 美感。

严格保持人物脸型、五官比例、眼睛、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、发型轮廓、身体比例、服装款式、服装颜色和服装材质一致。不要重新设计人物，不要更换服装，不要改变年龄、体型、人物身份或角色画风。

人物始终保持高品质 3D CG 角色质感，包括精细三维建模、平滑但保留立体结构的面部材质、细腻的次表面散射、稳定的皮肤 shader、高质量头发材质和清晰服装纹理。不要生成真人皮肤毛孔，不要出现真实摄影人像质感，不要改变为真人演员，不要改变为二次元平面插画风格。

[Shot 1]

高品质 3D 游戏 CG 过场动画质感，保持 <Picture 1> 原有角色渲染风格。高微对比，平滑高光过渡，精细 PBR 材质纹理，8K 母版级感知细节，清晰 2K 交付，24fps 电影运动模糊与细腻胶片颗粒。

黄昏时分的私密办公室，暖色 3200K 台灯与冷色 5600K 窗外光形成柔和对比。环境采用电影级写实 CG 渲染，但人物始终保持 <Picture 1> 原有的 3D 虚拟角色风格，不受写实环境影响，不转化为真人。

<Picture 1> 中的年轻女性站在透明玻璃办公桌前。她认真整理文件，并自然操作键盘，姿态端庄、沉稳、优雅。动作符合原角色的身体比例与关节结构，面部建模、发型轮廓、服装结构和身体造型在整个动作过程中保持稳定。

镜头以平视中景稳定起幅，随后缓慢向前推进，并轻微向右横移。镜头保持人物位于视觉中心，同时逐渐展现办公室环境和透明玻璃桌面。

人物面部始终清晰稳定，不发生五官漂移、脸型变化、风格跳变或真人化。身体比例不改变，服装不变形，头发不改变长度、颜色或造型。保持统一的三维模型、统一的材质 shader 和统一的角色渲染风格。

[Shot 2] 在00:05.000时镜头切换至高位斜侧俯拍。<Picture 1>人物此刻侧躺在透明玻璃办公桌上，身体侧弓，一腿压向胸口，另一腿大幅侧开。裙子被掀至胸口，一只肉色丝袜被撕烂挂在腿上，另一只扔在办公椅旁；文件与键盘散落一旁。她满身大汗，汗水顺着脖颈、锁骨、胸部与腰腹流淌。脸颊潮红，眼睛半闭带着水光，微微张嘴咬着下唇，表情迷醉又羞耻，头发凌乱湿贴。私处明显湿润，有爱液与混合体液顺着大腿内侧与玻璃桌面流下。胸膛因剧烈喘息而起伏。镜头以小幅度慢速弧形下移靠近，汗湿皮肤、布料褶皱与玻璃反光随视角真实变化，灯光逻辑与第一幕完全一致。

overall_soundscape: 安静办公室环境声：低沉空调嗡鸣、窗外隐约车流、细微布料摩擦与湿润皮肤贴合玻璃的声响，以及急促而压抑的喘息。无对白。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] <Picture 1> defines the visual identity of the luxury hotel: contemporary architecture, expansive floor-to-ceiling glass, an elevated infinity pool, elegant outdoor loungers, warm golden interior illumination, distant coastal city lights, mountain silhouettes, and the refined blue-hour luxury atmosphere. Preserve the same architectural language, material palette, pool design, warm-versus-cool color relationship, and premium hospitality aesthetic throughout the video. Do not reproduce the typography, slogan, logo, storyboard layout, or graphic-design elements from the reference image.

Create a premium 15-second cinematic luxury-hotel commercial with live-action architectural realism, Hasselblad X2D 100C medium-format aesthetic, natural color rendering, high micro-contrast, smooth highlight roll-off, realistic stone, glass, water, wood and textile materials, crisp 2K delivery, cinematic 24fps motion and subtle film grain.

The film opens at blue hour with a wide 28mm aerial establishing view of the hotel overlooking the coastline. The illuminated architecture sits between a deep cobalt sky and warm amber interior light. The infinity pool reflects the remaining sunset glow and nearby practical lights. The camera performs a slow, elegant forward descent toward the hotel with smooth acceleration, revealing landscaped terraces and the glowing glass facade. Water remains physically calm with subtle wind-driven ripples, and all reflections move consistently with the changing camera angle.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to pool level. A stylish adult female guest in an elegant flowing ivory resort dress walks slowly along the edge of the infinity pool toward the panoramic view. The camera tracks behind and slightly beside her at walking speed with a natural 35mm perspective. She first looks toward the horizon, then gently turns her gaze toward the illuminated hotel interior. Her dress and hair respond subtly to the evening breeze with natural delayed motion. Warm architectural lights create soft reflections across the pool surface while cool ambient skylight defines the exterior.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts into a premium ocean-view suite. A slow 35mm push-in travels from the entrance toward a large king-size bed and floor-to-ceiling glass windows overlooking the same coastline. Crisp white bedding, warm timber panels, natural stone, soft indirect lighting, minimal modern furniture and restrained luxury details remain visually consistent with the hotel exterior. Sheer curtains move gently in the conditioned airflow. The camera passes a foreground table with fresh flowers and refined glassware, creating natural parallax and shallow depth of field.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.500, the camera cuts to a refined hotel restaurant. A beautifully plated fine-dining course is placed onto a stone table beside the window by a professional server. The camera performs a slow 85mm macro-to-medium pull focus from the plated dish to two elegantly dressed guests seated beside the panoramic evening view. Reflections on glassware, polished cutlery and ceramic surfaces remain controlled and physically accurate. Warm 3000K practical lighting creates soft highlights without clipping.

[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts back to the rooftop infinity pool and terrace at night. The camera begins close to the shimmering water surface, then slowly pedals upward and pulls back with small amplitude to reveal the entire illuminated terrace, sophisticated lounge seating, warm restaurant interior and the coastal city sparkling in the distance. The pool visually merges with the dark horizon. Guests remain subtle background elements rather than focal subjects. The final composition settles into a symmetrical luxury advertising hero shot with clean negative space for brand graphics to be added in post-production. No generated logo, no random text, no distorted signage. Camera movement gradually decelerates and becomes perfectly stable at 15.00 seconds.

overall_soundscape: Gentle coastal wind, soft infinity-pool water movement and distant city ambience establish the exterior. Inside the suite and restaurant, subtle room tone, quiet fabric movement, restrained footsteps, delicate tableware contact and soft glass resonance remain spatially accurate and understated. No dialogue.

non_diegetic_music: Sophisticated luxury-commercial music built from soft piano, warm string pads, restrained electronic ambience and subtle low percussion at approximately 72 BPM. The arrangement gradually expands through the suite and dining sequence, then reaches a polished restrained crescendo during the final rooftop reveal before resolving on a clean sustained chord.
